tldr: Lilith in the 3rd house: the silenced voice and the forbidden thought
body: Lilith in the 3rd house: the silenced voice and the forbidden thought. Where you reclaim the right to say what others won't. Watch: a sharp or provocative tongue. You refuse to be silenced; your voice and daily thinking will not be policed. Buried intensity finds an outlet in writing and communication; thinking runs deep and unconventional. Putting the undercurrent into words is part of the reclamation. The source also links this placement to a significant early event or focus involving a sibling, which can leave a lasting imprint and calls for honest self-exploration.
business: Says the unsayable and thinks for itself.
shadow: A sharp, alienating tongue, or swallowed words that turn bitter.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith house material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
